protocol.extension_status: Project extension, not a claim of exact paper reproduction
protocol.speckle: x + x * N(0, variance), no clipping
protocol.salt_pepper: one spatial uniform draw, all RGB channels jointly 0 or 1
protocol.input: RGB /255; Gaussian/spatial/speckle not clipped; no CLIP normalization
protocol.inference: full-resolution batch1, right/bottom reflect-pad to multiple of 32
protocol.metrics: crop original size, clamp output [0,1], official RGB float *255 PSNR/SSIM, border0
protocol.aggregation: images equal; strengths equal within family; families equal; datasets equal
protocol.ood: Exclude Gaussian sigma15; official three-family and five-family extension scores separate
protocol.visual_selection: first two lexicographically sorted images per dataset, six fixed conditions
protocol.error_color_scale: mean absolute RGB error [0,0.20], shared fixed grayscale
protocol.signed_correction_scale: [-0.10,+0.10], shared fixed display; raw arrays preserved
protocol.runtime: 256x256 seeded tensor, batch1, 3 warmups, 10 forwards; synchronized CUDA
